Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human Aromatase (CHEMBL1978). Require canonical SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures (inner join). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
